reasons.plausibility: It follows well-established electron–phonon coupling arguments for BCS-type superconductors, though there are complexities in multi-component alloys.
reasons.testability: They propose clear compositional variations and direct measurements (electron–phonon coupling, Tc) that can decisively refute or confirm the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a specific pathway for tuning superconductivity in high-entropy alloys and a well-defined experiment for researchers to implement.
